name: code-chat-prs
about: A Code chat summary's Changes from the real gh (16 Nov 2026, agents/prs.rs; built 15 Nov in #128): test mode never runs the person's gh, so the summary said "Install GitHub's gh". Here the lab's read-only gh is on (`set --gh on`: agents/prs/lab.rs — only gh pr list / gh pr view, only on Yap's own public repository, every other command or flag refused before gh starts) and the scratch workspace is on a merged branch of that repository (`set --git`: no commit, nothing fetched). The summary lists the branch's pull requests — merged, with Archive — then, gh off again, says so quietly. Needs a live lab and Yap Code; one short question to the Code chat's Claude.

steps.note: A branch of Yap's own repository whose pull requests are merged (#139, #140).
